name: Elvira's Movie Macabre
description: Elvira, Mistress of the Dark, presents low-budget scary movies and provides sarcastic, campy commentary all while bringing the voluptuous charm & energy that only she can give.

videos.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre Halloween Special - The Texas Chainsaw Massacre
videos.overview: When Sally hears that her grandfather's grave may have been vandalized, she and her paraplegic brother, Franklin, set out with their friends to investigate. After a detour to their family's old farmhouse, they discover a group of crazed, murderous outcasts living next door. As the group is attacked one by one by the chainsaw-wielding Leatherface, who wears a mask of human skin, the survivors must do everything they can to escape.

videos.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre Halloween Special - Freddy's Dead: The Final Nightmare
videos.overview: Just when you thought it was safe to sleep, Freddy Krueger returns in this sixth installment of the Nightmare on Elm Street films, as psychologist Maggie Burroughs, tormented by recurring nightmares, meets a patient with the same horrific dreams. Their quest for answers leads to a certain house on Elm Street -- where the nightmares become reality.

videos.title: Grave of the Vampire
videos.overview: Vampire attacks woman and rapes her. Woman gives birth to a boy who must have mother`s blood instead of milk. When boy becomes an adult, he is determined to find and destroy his father.

videos.title: Silent Night, Bloody Night
videos.overview: The townspeople are upset when a man begins to research the history of his inheritance:  an old mansion that used to be used as a mental institution.

videos.title: The House That Screamed
videos.overview: Students begin to disappear from an all-girl boarding school.

videos.title: The Fall of the House of Usher
videos.overview: In search of the woman he loves, a young man goes to the ancestral home of the Ushers. He discovers a house of madness and death. The first Roger Corman Poe adaptation.

videos.title: The Dunwich Horror
videos.overview: Once upon a time, twins were born. One looks and acts human, the other is a many-headed creepy crawly. The human brother wants to bring ""the old ones"" from another dimension. He needs a book called the Necromicon and a human sacrifice. He picks Sandra Dee. ""Hey, look at me, I`m Sandra..."" Oops! Heh heh, wrong movie. Anyway, the creepy-crawly gets out and starts eating all the townspeople. That`ll drive down property values, I can tell ya. Based on H P Lovecraft story.

videos.title: Blacula
videos.overview: African Prince, cursed with vampirism, is shipped to the US and accidentally revived in the 1970`s. Talk about culture shock.

videos.title: The Comedy of Terrors
videos.overview: Business is so poor, a cash-strapped undertaker and his bumbling assistant decide to ""persuade"" people to become clients. Classic Vincent Price, Peter Lorre, Boris Karloff, and Basil Rathbone horror comedy.

videos.title: The Thing With Two Heads
videos.overview: White bigot plans to have his head transplanted to another man`s body. He is dying and this is his idea to thwart death. Without his knowledge, his head is transplanted onto a black convict`s body. And the convict still has his own head.

videos.title: The Werewolf of Washington
videos.overview: After returning from Hungary, a reporter is appointed a press secretary to th US President. Unknown by all, he is a werewolf. Horror comedy.

videos.title: Cry of the Banshee
videos.overview: Evil ruler with an obsessive hatred for witchcraft, destroys a witches coven. The head witch puts a curse on his entire family. Title creature begins killing family members one by one.

videos.title: Count Yorga, Vampire
videos.overview: Modern (circa 1970) vampire causes havoc amongst some twentysomthings in Los Angeles.

videos.title: Murders in the Rue Morgue
videos.overview: Masked man is killing members of a theatre troupe. Film has very little to do with Edgar Allan Poe.

videos.title: Baron Blood
videos.overview: Visiting his ancestral castle, a young man accidentally brings the sadistic title fiend back to life. Oops!

videos.title: Dr Jekyll and Sister Hyde
videos.overview: A novel twist to the classic tale. When Jekyll drinks his potion, he turns into a woman!

videos.title: The Crimson Cult
videos.overview: In search of his missing brother, a man discovers witchcraft at a country estate. Boris Karloff`s last A film.

videos.title: The Murder Clinic
videos.overview: Someone or something is killing inmates and medical personnel at a mental institution.

videos.title: Horror Express
videos.overview: Ape-like creature, found frozen on an archeological dig, thaws out and begins killing people on board a train traveling across Siberia.

videos.title: The Incredible 2-Headed Transplant
videos.overview: Doctor transplants the head of a psychotic killer onto the body of a retarded young man.

videos.title: Horror Hospital
videos.overview: Doctor and his wacky wife experiment on people who answer their newspaper advertisement.

videos.title: Rattlers
videos.overview: Rattlesnakes high on nerve gas decide to kick some human butt.

videos.title: Disciple of Death
videos.overview: One of Satan`s own is accidentally brought back to life. (here we go again) He immediately begins searching for women to sacrifice to his boss.

videos.title: Frankenstein
videos.overview: Still another version of the classic tale. This time the monster is more sympathetic. A Dan Curtis production.

videos.title: The Devil's Rain
videos.overview: If you cross these satan worshippers, you end up as a puddle on the floor.

videos.title: Psychic Killer
videos.overview: After learning astral projection from a fellow inmate in a mental institution, a man uses it to kill people who tick him off.

videos.title: Necromancy
videos.overview: Warlock wants to bring his dead son back to life.

videos.title: The Spectre of Edgar Allen Poe
videos.overview: Poe believes something strange is going on at the asylum where the love of his life, Lenore, is an inmate.

videos.title: Peeping Tom
videos.overview: Man films his victims as he kills them. Classic film.

videos.title: Legacy of Blood
videos.overview: Heirs to fortune must spend the night in their late father`s mansion. Someone or something begins to kill them one by one.

videos.title: Deathdream
videos.overview: Family is notified that their son was killed in action while serving in Vietnam. The same day, the son returns but everyone begins to realize something is horribly wrong with him. Updated version of The Monkey`s Paw.

videos.title: The Deathmaster
videos.overview: Vampire becomes the head of a commune of hippies.

videos.title: Beware! The Blob
videos.overview: A piece of the original blob accidentally thaws out. Critter begins gobbling up everyone it comes in contact with.

videos.title: Good Against Evil
videos.overview: Exorcists vs devil worshippers.

videos.title: The Brotherhood of Satan
videos.overview: Still more devil worshippers. They recruit(read kidnap)kids for their cult.

videos.title: The Mad Magician
videos.overview: Magician and master of disguise takes revenge on those who screwed him over.

videos.title: The Turn of the Screw
videos.overview: The new governess at a country estate begins to see ghosts. Are they real or is she mad?

videos.title: Count Dracula's Great Love
videos.overview: Four women take refuge in a castle after their coach breaks down. Guess who lives there?

videos.title: Jennifer The Snake Goddess
videos.overview: Girl has ability to control snakes. She uses them to take revenge on classmates who torment her.

videos.title: Masque of the Red Death
videos.overview: Believing Satan protects him and his privileged guests from the plague that is ravaging the countryside, an evil count torments selected victims. Classic Price/Poe/Corman film.

videos.title: The Tomb of Ligeia
videos.overview: Man believes his new wife is possessed by the ghost of his first wife.

videos.title: The Incredible Melting Man
videos.overview: After returning from a space mission, astronaut begins to turn to liquid. Bloody mess, what?

videos.title: The Fearless Vampire Killers
videos.overview: Van Helsing-like professor and his bumbling assistant hunt vampires. They stumble onto the mother lode. Classic horror comedy.

videos.title: Terror House
videos.overview: Guests are on the menu at the Red Wolf Inn.

videos.title: The Baby
videos.overview: Social worker investigates bizarre family where the twentysomething son is kept in diapers and treated like an infant!

videos.title: The House of Seven Corpses
videos.overview: Someone or something is killing members of a production crew filming a movie in an old dark house.

videos.title: Psychomania
videos.overview: Hell raising bikers discover that, if they commit suicide, they can return from the dead and raise even more hell.

videos.title: Whoever Slew Auntie Roo?
videos.overview: Modern version of Hansel and Gretel. Wacko lures kids into her old dark house. Pie anyone?

videos.title: War- Gods of the Deep
videos.overview: Vincent Price leads a band of immortal men who live in a series of caves beneath the sea. Directed by Jacques Tourenur.

videos.title: The Oblong Box
videos.overview: Man cursed by witchdoctor returns from Africa to torment his brother. Vincent Price stars with an assist by Christopher Lee.

videos.title: The Raven
videos.overview: Classic comedy horror film starring Vincent Price, Peter Lorre, and Boris Karloff. Yep, that`s a very young Jack Nicholson playing Lorre`s son. Directed by Roger Corman.

videos.title: The Conqueror Worm
videos.overview: Merciless man hunts down witches in the name of the king. Vincent Price is pure evil in ultra violent film. British title is Witchfinder General.

videos.title: And Now the Screaming Starts!
videos.overview: In 1795, a young bride moves into her husband`s mansion. Is it haunted or is she losing her mind? Peter Cushing saves this film.

videos.title: Blood from the Mummy's Tomb
videos.overview: The mummy of an evil queen is brought back from Egypt. The daughter of the expedition`s leader is possessed by the soul of the evil queen. When the daughter becomes a young woman, members of the expedition begin to be murdered one by one.

videos.title: Madhouse
videos.overview: Vincent Price plays an aging star of horror films. He becomes a suspect in a series of murders.

videos.title: The House That Dripped Blood
videos.overview: Film made up of short horror tales. Similar to films like Tales From the Crypt, Asylum, Vault of Horror.

videos.title: Tales of Terror
videos.overview: Another monster fest with three tales based on Poe short stories or poems. Starring Vincent Price, Peter Lorre, and Basil Rathbone. Directed by Roger Corman.

videos.title: The Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde
videos.overview: The first of many TV horror movies produced and directed by Dan Curtis of Dark Shadows fame. Jack Palance is excellent in the title roles.

videos.title: The Day It Came to Earth
videos.overview: Dead gangster is brought back to ""life"" by radiation from a meteorite.

videos.title: Blood on Satan's Claw
videos.overview: A group of children in 17th century England form a devil cult.

videos.title: Crucible of Horror
videos.overview: An evil man rules his family with an iron hand. His wife and daughter plot to kill him. But is he really dead?

videos.title: Dr Black, Mr Hyde
videos.overview: Another novel twist on the classic tale. When Dr Black drinks his potion, he turns white!

videos.title: The Devil Within Her
videos.overview: After being cursed by a dwarf, a woman`s baby appears to be possessed by a demon.

videos.title: The Bat People
videos.overview: Bitten by a bat, a scientist turns into a bat creature. A different take on the werewolf legend.

videos.title: The Return of Count Yorga
videos.overview: The Count returns for another round of death and destruction.

videos.title: Inn of the Frightened People
videos.overview: A man and woman take revenge on the creep who murdered their daughter.

videos.title: Craze
videos.overview: A man believes that an African idol grants him good luck when he sacrifices women to it.

videos.title: The Monster Club
videos.overview: Three tales of the supernatural. The wraparounds feature Vincent Price and John Carradine.

videos.title: The Creature's Revenge
videos.overview: A mad scientist transplants the brain of a dying ruler into the body of an idiot. Another Al Adamson mess.

videos.title: Beast of the Dead
videos.overview: The second of the blood trilogy filmed in the Philippines. John Ashley returns to battle a mad scientist and his gobble-de-goop monster.

videos.title: The Torture Chamber of Dr Sadism
Lemora: A Child's Tale of the Supernatural
Willard
videos.overview: A young man makes friends with a super intelligent rat. When anyone angers him, the rat and his buddies tear the offender to pieces.

videos.title: Maneater of Hydra
videos.overview: Mad doctor invites some people to his island. Something begins to kill them one by one. The phrase ""buckets of blood"" describes this gory film. Yecch!

videos.title: Gamera Super Monster
videos.overview: ""Well, lookee there, Ma. Ain`t that the biggest durn tu`tle you eva saw?"" ""Oh, go on, Pa. Grandper usta pull bigga ones than that outa Skunk Holler Crick.""

videos.title: Night of the Zombies
videos.overview: Dead WW II soldiers have been kept animated by some type of gas.

videos.title: The Navy vs the Night Monsters
Yeti: The Giant of the 20th Century
House of Dark Shadows
videos.overview: The TV gothic soap opera comes to the big screen. Far more violent and graphic than TV series.

videos.title: The Mighty Gorga
videos.overview: A circus owner travels to Africa in search of a giant ape.

videos.title: Scream, Baby, Scream
videos.overview: Demented artist uses zombies to kidnap hippies for use in his experiments to create human art.

videos.title: Strait-Jacket
videos.overview: A woman is haunted by visions of bloody death after moving into a house where a murder was committed.

videos.title: The Two Faces of Dr Jekyll
Children Shouldn't Play with Dead Things
Nightmare City
videos.overview: A plane is zapped with radiation which turns everyone on board into flesh-eating zombies. These zombies can still think and even use weapons on their victims.
